name: Bounded negative-mouth review PNG LFS pilot
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - cloud/mouth-negative-lfs-pilot-20261023
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/mouth-negative-lfs-pilot.yml
permissions: {}
jobs:
  upload-and-verify:
    if: github.repository == 'qianyizhang/med-assets' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/cloud/mouth-negative-lfs-pilot-20261023'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0'
      APPROVED_MANIFEST: >-
        {"objects":[{"oid":"3d66cb2e502a66cad6c15137fb8a82750e43da911f2be7a6102a7dd87d5d979a","size":500392,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/negative/draft_mouth__context_rejected_20261023/3d66cb2e502a66cad6c15137fb8a82750e43da911f2be7a6102a7dd87d5d979a.png","type":"png","file":"reviews/draft_mouth/2026-10-23-context-rejected/context-before-after-comparison.png"}]}
    steps:
      - name: Configure temporary repository authentication
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          lfs: false
          submodules: false
          sparse-checkout: .gitattributes
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: true
          show-progress: false
      - name: Verify sources, upload missing among 1 exact PNG OIDs, and independently read back
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import gzip, hashlib, io, json, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, urllib.parse, urllib.request
          
          manifest = json.loads(os.environ["APPROVED_MANIFEST"])
          objects = manifest["objects"]
          assert len(objects) == 1 and len({o["oid"] for o in objects}) == 1, "Unexpected object count"
          assert sum(o["size"] for o in objects) == 500392, "Unexpected total bytes"
          assert sum(o["size"] for o in objects) <= 500392, "Approved batch cap exceeded"
          assert max(o["size"] for o in objects) <= 500392, "Per-object limit exceeded"
          assert all(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", o["oid"]) and 0 < o["size"] <= 500392 for o in objects), "Invalid object constraints"
          work = pathlib.Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"], "mouth-negative-approved-pilot")
          work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          
          # Every source is public. Do not read or pass GitHub credentials to source URLs.
          for o in objects:
              parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(o["url"])
              assert parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.hostname in {"anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site"}, "Unapproved source host"
              assert parsed.username is None and parsed.password is None, "Credentials in URL refused"
              encoding = o.get("encoding", "identity")
              assert encoding in {"identity", "gzip"}, "Unapproved source encoding"
              transfer_size = o.get("transportSize", o["size"])
              transfer_oid = o.get("transportOid", o["oid"])
              assert 0 < transfer_size <= 500392 and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", transfer_oid), "Invalid transport constraints"
              if encoding == "gzip":
                  assert "transportSize" in o and "transportOid" in o, "Gzip transport manifest required"
              else:
                  assert transfer_size == o["size"] and transfer_oid == o["oid"], "Identity transport mismatch"
              req = urllib.request.Request(o["url"], headers={"User-Agent": "med-assets-mouth-negative-pilot/1.0", "Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as response:
                  assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(response.url).scheme == "https", "Non-HTTPS redirect refused"
                  transport = response.read(transfer_size + 1)
              assert len(transport) == transfer_size and hashlib.sha256(transport).hexdigest() == transfer_oid, "Transport size or SHA-256 mismatch"
              if encoding == "gzip":
                  with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=io.BytesIO(transport)) as compressed:
                      data = compressed.read(o["size"] + 1)
              else:
                  data = transport
              assert len(data) == o["size"], "Source size mismatch"
              assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == o["oid"], "Source SHA-256 mismatch"
              if o["type"] == "png":
                  assert data[:8] == bytes([137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10]), "Source is not PNG"
              elif o["type"] == "glb":
                  assert data[:4] == b"glTF", "Source is not GLB"
              elif o["type"] == "webp":
                  assert data[:4] == b"RIFF" and data[8:12] == b"WEBP", "Source is not WebP"
              else:
                  raise AssertionError("Unapproved content type")
              (work / o["oid"]).write_bytes(data)
              print(f"SOURCE VERIFIED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes", flush=True)
          
          subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "version"], check=True)
          subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "install", "--local"], check=True)
          # Validate every LFS pointer before uploading any object.
          for o in objects:
              with (work / o["oid"]).open("rb") as source:
                  clean = subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "clean", "approved-" + o["oid"]], stdin=source, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, check=True)
              expected = f"version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1\noid sha256:{o['oid']}\nsize {o['size']}\n".encode()
              assert clean.stdout == expected, "Generated LFS pointer mismatch"
          # Query destination again and upload only genuinely missing approved objects.
          preflight_endpoint = "https://github.com/qianyizhang/med-assets.git/info/lfs/objects/batch"
          preflight_payload = json.dumps({"operation":"download","transfers":["basic"],"objects":[{"oid":o["oid"],"size":o["size"]} for o in objects]}).encode()
          preflight_headers = {"Accept":"application/vnd.git-lfs+json","Content-Type":"application/vnd.git-lfs+json"}
          with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(preflight_endpoint,data=preflight_payload,headers=preflight_headers),timeout=45) as response:
              preflight_result = json.load(response)
          preflight_objects = {o["oid"]:o for o in preflight_result.get("objects",[])}
          assert set(preflight_objects) == {o["oid"] for o in objects}, "Unexpected preflight objects"
          missing = set()
          for o in objects:
              remote = preflight_objects[o["oid"]]
              assert remote.get("size") == o["size"]
              error = remote.get("error")
              if error:
                  assert error.get("code") == 404, "Destination returned an error other than missing object; stop"
                  missing.add(o["oid"])
              else:
                  assert remote.get("actions",{}).get("download"), "Destination unavailable"
          for o in objects:
              if o["oid"] not in missing:
                  print(f"ALREADY PRESENT SKIPPED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes",flush=True)
                  continue
              subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "push", "--object-id", "origin", o["oid"]], check=True)
              print(f"UPLOAD COMMAND PASSED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes", flush=True)
          
          # Independent HTTP readback, without the local LFS cache or GitHub user credentials.
          endpoint = "https://github.com/qianyizhang/med-assets.git/info/lfs/objects/batch"
          payload = json.dumps({"operation": "download", "transfers": ["basic"], "objects": [{"oid": o["oid"], "size": o["size"]} for o in objects]}).encode()
          headers = {"Accept": "application/vnd.git-lfs+json", "Content-Type": "application/vnd.git-lfs+json", "User-Agent": "med-assets-mouth-negative-pilot-readback/1.0"}
          with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(endpoint, data=payload, headers=headers), timeout=45) as response:
              result = json.load(response)
          returned = {o["oid"]: o for o in result.get("objects", [])}
          assert set(returned) == {o["oid"] for o in objects}, "Unexpected LFS Batch objects"
          for expected in objects:
              obj = returned[expected["oid"]]
              assert obj.get("size") == expected["size"] and "error" not in obj, "GitHub object unavailable"
              action = obj.get("actions", {}).get("download")
              assert action and urllib.parse.urlsplit(action["href"]).scheme == "https", "Invalid LFS download action"
              req = urllib.request.Request(action["href"], headers=action.get("header", {}))
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as response:
                  assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(response.url).scheme == "https", "Non-HTTPS LFS redirect refused"
                  data = response.read(expected["size"] + 1)
              assert len(data) == expected["size"] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected["oid"], "GitHub LFS readback mismatch"
              print(f"GITHUB READBACK VERIFIED {expected['oid']} {len(data)} bytes", flush=True)
          print("PASS: 1 exact objects; 500392 bytes; no Git asset pointer or branch-tip commit pushed by this job.", flush=True)
          PY
